title: H183 — Network Momentum (Lead-Lag Cross-Sectional Momentum, arXiv:2501.07135)
rationale: Lim et al. (Jan 2025, arXiv:2501.07135) combine univariate time-series trend with cross-sectional momentum via lead-lag network connectivity between markets. Network momentum captures momentum *spillover* between related stocks/sectors — e.g., NVDA's move predicts AMD's move the next day. This directly addresses H157's failure (factor ETF rotation NOT CONFIRMED at monthly frequency) by working at the sector/stock level with daily lead-lag. The approach is orthogonal to H026 (monthly sector rotation) and complementary to H156 (stock momentum). If cross-asset lead-lag exists in our large-cap universe, this could provide a confirmed daily signal. Estimated 4-6h. Queue after H181/H182 since those are closer to confirmed family.
content: New hypothesis: H183 — Network Momentum. Implement lead-lag cross-sectional momentum on 30-100 large-cap US stocks. Signal: for each stock i, compute correlation of i's t-1 return with j's t return for all j≠i; identify 'leaders' (stocks whose past return predicts future returns of others). Portfolio: long stocks with high network-momentum score (many leading stocks showed positive returns yesterday). Universe: 30-50 large-cap stocks. Daily rebalance (or weekly to reduce turnover). IS: 2020-2023, OOS: 2024+. Confirm: OOS Sharpe > 0.5, stable leader network over time.
